jsonld.text: Who Makes The Best Fiberglass Pool In Canada? Canada's climate, with its dramatic freeze-thaw cycles, demands a pool that can withstand the elements. For many homeowners, fiberglass pools offer the perfect blend of durability and aesthetic appeal. But with so many manufacturers out there, how do you choose the right one? At Hipel Pools, we've installed over 100 fiberglass pools from just about every brand across Ontario, giving us a unique perspective on the best in the business. Here's our take on the top 5 fiberglass pool manufacturers in Canada, based on our firsthand experience and customer feedback. 1. Azoria Fiberglass Pools Headquarters: Located in Quebec, Canada. Manufacturing: Azoria utilizes a state-of-the-art manufacturing process in Trenton, Ontario as well as Daveluyville Quebec, focusing on precision and quality control. They employ advanced resin technology and multi-layered fiberglass construction for enhanced durability. Strengths: Azoria stands out for its exceptional customer service and support. Their Dolphin Fiberglass Collection and Aquarino Collection offer a wide range of modern designs. Azoria also has superb warranty support. Pool Sizes and Shapes: Offers a diverse range of pools, from classic rectangles to freeform designs, catering to various backyard sizes and styles. Disadvantages: Consumer reviews sometimes mention longer lead times during peak season, likely due to high demand. Hipel's Insight: Azoria’s dedication to customer satisfaction is truly commendable. 2. Latham Fiberglass Pools Headquarters: Based in the United States, with a strong presence in Canada. Manufacturing: Latham employs advanced manufacturing techniques, including proprietary resin formulations and meticulous layering processes. They are known for their high-gloss, durable finishes. Strengths: Latham is renowned for its high-quality finishes, offering a luxurious look and feel. They have the nicest finish of any brand. Pool Sizes and Shapes: Offers a comprehensive selection of pool shapes and sizes, including various tanning ledges and spa combinations. Disadvantages: Consumer reviews indicate that warranty support could be improved. Hipel's Insight: The finish on a Latham pool is truly exceptional, adding a touch of elegance to any backyard. 3. Imagine Pools Headquarters: Based in the United States, with a strong distribution network in Canada. Manufacturing: Imagine Pools focuses on innovative designs and advanced composite technology. Their manufacturing process emphasizes precision molding and reinforced structural integrity. Strengths: Imagine Pools is known for its innovative designs and features, including built-in spas, benches, and water features. They have some of the best pool designs and features. Pool Sizes and Shapes: Offers a wide array of contemporary designs, including unique shapes and sizes to fit diverse backyards. Disadvantages: Some consumer reviews mention inconsistencies in warranty support. Hipel's Insight: Imagine Pools consistently pushes the boundaries of design, offering pools that are both functional and visually stunning. 4. Leisure Pools Headquarters: Based in Australia, with a significant presence in Canada. Manufacturing: Leisure Pools utilizes a patented Composite Armour™ manufacturing process, which involves multiple layers of high-performance materials for exceptional strength and durability. Strengths: Leisure Pools excels in its pool designs and features, emphasizing durability and longevity. They have some of the best pool designs and features. Pool Sizes and Shapes: Offers a vast selection of pools, from traditional to modern designs, with various sizes and shapes to suit different preferences. Disadvantages: Consumer feedback indicates room for improvement in warranty support. Hipel's Insight: Leisure Pools' commitment to quality and innovation is evident in their diverse product range. 5. Thursday Pools Headquarters: Based in the United States, with a growing presence in Canada. Manufacturing: Thursday Pools is one of the most progressive fiberglass pool manufacturers in the world continually developing new technologies that make Thursday Pools stand out Strengths: Thursday Pools offers a solid range of fiberglass pools, known for their reliability and overall quality. They have superb customer and warranty support. Pool Sizes and Shapes: Offers a variety of pool shapes and sizes, including rectangular, freeform, and kidney-shaped designs. Disadvantages: Some consumers feel that their design options are not as expansive as other brands. Hipel's Insight: Thursday Pools is a dependable choice for homeowners seeking a reliable fiberglass pool. What is the Life Expectancy of a Fiberglass Pool? One of the significant advantages of fiberglass pools is their longevity. With proper installation and maintenance, a high-quality fiberglass pool can easily last 25 to 30 years, and often even longer. The durable gelcoat finish resists algae growth and requires minimal chemical treatment, contributing to its extended lifespan. Unlike vinyl liner pools that require liner replacements every 9-12 years, or concrete pools that need resurfacing, fiberglass pools offer a more enduring solution. Factors influencing the life expectancy include the quality of the manufacturing process, the initial installation, and ongoing maintenance practices. Choosing a reputable manufacturer and a skilled installer, like Hipel Pools, is crucial for maximizing the lifespan of your fiberglass pool. How Much Does a Fiberglass Pool Cost in Canada? The cost of a fiberglass pool in Canada can vary significantly based on several factors, including the size and shape of the pool, the manufacturer, the complexity of the installation, and any additional features or accessories. On average, you can expect to invest anywhere from $65,000 to $120,000 or more for a complete fiberglass pool installation. This range typically includes the cost of the pool shell, excavation, delivery, installation, plumbing, electrical work, and basic landscaping. Here's a breakdown of potential cost factors: Pool Shell: The cost of the fiberglass pool shell itself varies depending on the manufacturer, size, and design. Excavation and Site Preparation: The complexity of the excavation process, including soil conditions and accessibility, can impact the cost. Installation: Installation costs include labor, plumbing, electrical work, and backfilling. Additional Features: Features like built-in spas, water features, lighting, and automated systems will increase the overall cost. Landscaping and Decking: Surrounding landscaping and decking can add significant costs, depending on the materials and design. Permits and Inspections: Local permits and inspections are necessary and will add to the overall expense. It's essential to obtain a detailed quotes from a reputable pool builder, including Hipel Pools, to accurately assess the cost of your project. Remember that while the initial investment may be higher compared to other pool types, the long-term maintenance costs of a fiberglass pool are generally lower, making it a cost-effective choice in the long run. The Importance of Choosing the Right Pool Builder While selecting a reputable fiberglass pool manufacturer is important, the installation process is equally as critical. Even the highest-quality pool can be compromised by a bad pool builder. A skilled and experienced pool builder can ensure that your pool is installed correctly, maximizing its longevity and performance. While you may be tempted to choose a builder based on the pool brand they sell. We would highly suggest choosing a reputable builder and going with the pool brand they install. A bad builder can easily ruin a great fiberglass pool. At Hipel Pools, we understand the nuances of fiberglass pool installation. We have the expertise to handle any challenges and ensure that your pool is installed to the highest standards. Rather than focusing solely on the brand of pool, focus on finding the best pool builder in your region. Hipel Pools: Your Fiberglass Pool Experts With our extensive experience installing fiberglass pools from all these top manufacturers, Hipel Pools can provide valuable insights and guidance. We understand the nuances of each brand and can help you make an informed decision. Contact us today for a consultation and let us help you create the backyard oasis of your dreams.

What is the Life Expectancy of a Fiberglass Pool?

One of the significant advantages of fiberglass pools is their longevity.
